## Problem / User Story

> What problem does this feature solve?
> Who benefits from it?
> Example: "As a [user type], I want to [action] so that [goal]."

## Proposed Solution

> Describe the feature you'd like to see.

## Alternative Solutions Considered

> Describe alternatives you considered and why you chose this approach.

## Database Impact

> Does this feature require new tables, columns, or migrations?

- [ ] No database changes needed
- [ ] New table(s) required

## API Impact

> Does this feature require new or modified API endpoints?

- [ ] No API changes needed
- [ ] New endpoint(s) required

> Any mockups, diagrams, or additional information.
